source.description: One reviewed six-panel graphite-and-colored-pencil contact sheet cropped into five cumulative process frames and one finished master.
source.notes: Keep one whole lemon on a shallow diagonal, one cut lemon slice leaning in front, one short stem, exactly two leaves, exactly eight slice segments, sparse rind dimples, open paper highlights, and one broken ground shadow in one stable composition.

process_strategy: Reserve the whole lemon, foreground slice, stem, two leaves, eight slice divisions, highlights, and shadow in pale graphite; develop those same envelopes into persistent contours and botanical detail; establish texture and restrained yellow-green color before limiting the final panel to keeper-line, value, and highlight cleanup.

final_elements.name: pale lemon slice leaf segment highlight and shadow construction
final_elements.description: Light graphite envelopes for one angled whole lemon, one foreground slice, one short stem, exactly two leaves, eight radial slice divisions, open highlights, and one broken shadow footprint.

final_elements.name: whole lemon stem two leaves and foreground slice contours
final_elements.description: One dimpled oval lemon with a tapered end, one short stem, exactly two overlapping leaves, and one circular cut slice leaning in front of the fruit.

final_elements.name: slice rind eight segments leaf veins and overlap breaks
final_elements.description: A doubled slice rind, exactly eight citrus segments, simple veins in both leaves, and clear contour breaks where the slice and leaves overlap the whole lemon.

final_elements.name: rind dimples curved graphite hatching highlights and broken shadow
final_elements.description: Sparse peel dimples, directional graphite hatching, reserved paper highlights, and one broken graphite ground shadow.

final_elements.name: restrained lemon-yellow leaf-green and warm-ochre colored-pencil accents
final_elements.description: Layered lemon yellow on the fruit and slice, leaf green on both leaves, warm ochre near the rind and shadow, with graphite texture and paper highlights preserved.

rejection_checks: Keep one whole lemon, one foreground slice, one short stem, two leaves, one crop, and one scale in all six panels.
Keep exactly eight slice segments after they appear, with one doubled rind and no segment-count drift.
The whole lemon must stop behind the foreground slice, leaf stems must stop at the fruit, and the shadow must stop at both citrus silhouettes; no keeper line may be erased to fake an overlap.
Do not add a glass, plate, knife, blossom, second fruit, face, lettering, arrows, labels, numbers, signature, watermark, or decorative border.
The final panel may not introduce a contour, leaf, segment, dimple cluster, hatch route, shadow shape, highlight, or color area.
The finish must look like tactile graphite and colored pencil on warm paper, not polished food illustration, photorealism, or rasterized vector art.
